title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
description: Given a string s, find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.
hints: Expand a window until you see a duplicate, then shrink from the left until the duplicate is gone.
Track character → most recent index in a hash map to know how far to jump the window's left edge.
solution_approach: Maintain two pointers (left, right) and a frequency map. Expand right, and whenever a character repeats, move left forward until the window has all unique characters. Track the maximum window size.
common_mistakes: Not advancing the left pointer enough when a character repeats.
Confusing substring (contiguous) with subsequence (order-preserving, not contiguous).
similar_problems: Longest Substring with At Most K Distinct Characters
